selected.title: A NASA telescope may soon fall back to Earth
selected.summary: NASA’s Swift space telescope is nearing an uncontrolled return to Earth after a rescue attempt failed. Its remaining debris is expected to fall into the ocean.
selected.why_it_matters: Swift has tracked cosmic explosions for over two decades; its loss raises questions about how we protect valuable space observatories from orbital decay.
selected.challenge_question: Where is the surviving wreckage from NASA’s Swift telescope most likely to fall?
selected.answer_explanation: AP reports that any surviving wreckage will most likely plunge into the ocean as Swift re-enters Earth’s atmosphere.
selected.butterfly_question: When an aging satellite can’t be rescued, who should plan for its safe return—and what science might we lose?
